question: In right angle ΔABC, right angled at B, if tanA = sqrt{3} then sinAcosC + cosAsinC = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84e1b89348f853366f5ad39ef56b5838ff1243b47b41ff7f8998da6acb6aa75f.png] 

**Given**

tanA = √{3}

**Concept used**

sinθ = side opposite to θ /Hypotenuse

cosθ = side adjacent to θ/Hypotenuse

Calculation

AC = √(3)² + 1

AC = √3 + 1

AC = √4

AC = 2

sinA = BC/AC = √3/2

cosC = BC/AC = √3/2

cosA = AB/AC = 1/2

sinC = AB/AC = 1/2

So,

sin A cos C + cos A sin C =

(√3/2) × (√3/2) + (1/2) × (1/2)

⇒ (3/4) + (1/4)

⇒ (3 +1)/4

⇒ 4/4

⇒ 1

**∴ sinAcosC + cosAsinC is 1**
